sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 860. Deal magic damage (Wind) 2 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Flank for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction: Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Burial Eclipse (decreases all stats by 40%, decreases physical and magic Ability Power by 100, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by 50) to the enemy field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Stun and Beguilement Resistance Up by 70
